==Are ''sa'angreal'' just powerful ''an'greal''?==
I would disagree that ''sa'angreal'' are a specific kind of ''an'greal''. As I recall, there are two distinct categories of object. I just checked the glossary entry for ''sa'angreal'' in ''[[A Crown of Swords]]'', and it clearly considers them distinct from ''angreal'', saying, for example, "A ''sa'angreal'' is similar to, but more powerful than, an ''angreal''." [[User:Eric119|Eric119]] 04:58, 24 January 2006 (UTC)
:I think the 'similar to' is referring to its function, which is what I'm talking about when I say "a more powerful ''angreal''." There may be other qualities of a ''sa'angreal'' that separates its function from that of a normal ''angreal'', but they have not been mentioned (to my knowledge) in any of the canon.[[User:Mhoskins|Mhoskins]] 15:52, 24 January 2006 (UTC)
::Well, about half the glossary entry is contrasting ''angreal'' and ''sa'angreal'', as in, "Only a handful remain, far fewer even than ''angreal''." In particular, I would consider calling ''Callandor'' an ''angreal'' to be incorrect. [[User:Eric119|Eric119]] 05:51, 25 January 2006 (UTC)

==Stacking ''angreal/sa'angreal''==
I just wondered whether it would be possible to "stack" ''angreal'' and be able to draw greater amounts of the one power by just using multiple angreal at the same time. Anyone knows something about this? [[User:Seanor Lightbringer|Seanor Lightbringer]] 18:43, June 8, 2010 (UTC)
:Yes. When Rand and Asmodean were "fighting" over the Choedan Kal access key, they were deadlocked until Rand drew on the fat man ''angreal'' he had in his coat. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 18:52, June 8, 2010 (UTC)
